summary.zh: 声称完成前先跑验证并给出证据
summary.en: Run the checks before claiming done

description.zh:
在说「做完了/修好了/测试通过」之前，先运行验证命令并核对输出。
要求用证据代替断言，避免未经验证的完成声明。
description.en:
Before saying done, fixed, or passing, run the verification commands and check the output.
Evidence before assertions: never claim success without running it.
